question: At exactly matched total sparse coordinates, does a third task-selected directed residual-mixer stage close the remaining c_fc oracle gap left by the reliable two-stage product?
authorization: One zero-persistent-update three-stage directed-product bracket only. No training, learned basis, LoRA, HyperConnection, residual-topology change, larger rung, watchdog, callback, queue worker, or heartbeat is authorized.

protocol.fit: Greedy three-stage residual product. Every stage fits the remaining exact historical dense-Muon c_fc update from columns transformed by all preceding stages, yielding explicit higher-order product terms while holding total sparse coordinates fixed.
protocol.matched_controls: Recompute directed44/directed88 and product22x2/product44x2 on the identical replay and held-out windows. The 44-total and 88-total three-stage schedules use exactly the same coordinate counts as their one- and two-stage controls.
protocol.fixed_radius: Globally normalize only each final BF16 c_fc endpoint to the deployed production c_fc family Frobenius norm.
protocol.exact_restore: Restore every BF16 materialized MLP tensor around every candidate and persist zero model or optimizer updates to the checkpoint.

decision_rule.reliable_improvement: Candidate-minus-production 99% CI upper bound below zero and negative mean on every held-out window.
decision_rule.oracle_gate: Equal-radius dense c_fc must reliably beat production both alone and beside production c_proj on the new windows.
decision_rule.three_stage_pass: A three-stage level must reliably beat production both alone and beside production c_proj, recover at least 25% of the same-window dense c_fc oracle gap in the worse attribution, and at least 40% on average.
decision_rule.selection: Select 44-total if it passes; otherwise select 88-total only if it passes. Matched-depth controls are retained as mechanistic evidence but do not replace the production and oracle gates.
decision_rule.architecture_gate: A pass authorizes production implementation and an MFU preflight only; it does not directly authorize training or a larger rung.

execution.monitoring: direct foreground polling only; no watchdog, callback, queue worker, or heartbeat
